cat AGENTS.md docs/features/checkout.md docs/features/payments.md docs/features/sessions.md docs/architecture.md && rg -n -i 'cancel|cutoff|packing|pickup|phone' . --glob '!.git/**' --glob '!.agents/**' --glob '!.claude/**' && git log -6 --oneline && rg --files larder tests

git diff --check && git diff -- docs/features/README.md && cat docs/features/cancellation.md && python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
import re
from larder.cancellation import can_cancel
pickup = datetime(2026, 10, 30, 17)
cutoff = pickup - timedelta(hours=2)
assert can_cancel(pickup, cutoff - timedelta(microseconds=1))
assert not can_cancel(pickup, cutoff)
assert not can_cancel(pickup, cutoff + timedelta(microseconds=1))
for path in (Path('docs/features/cancellation.md'), Path('docs/features/README.md')):
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
        assert (path.parent / target.split('#')[0]).exists(), (path, target)
print('Cutoff examples and documentation links verified.')
PY
